name: Franklin Recreation Department Summer Camp
description_short: A town-run day camp at King Street Memorial Park. It runs 8:30am to 3:30pm and includes outdoor activities, arts & crafts, gaga ball, playgrounds and a weekly Wednesday field trip that is covered by the camp fee.

warnings: Today is 2026-10-13. This page describes the 2026 season (registration began March 2, 2026), which is already over. Details for 2027 have not been posted.
The page lists 8 weeks with a field trip for each, but gives no dates for any week, so no sessions were recorded.
Field trips happen on Wednesdays and all staff go. Campers who skip the trip cannot attend camp that day.
Extended care (early drop-off or late pick-up) costs an extra $10 per day per child in 2026.
